title: VOL 9 — Test 2 (Reading + Listening)
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

parts.title: Re-creating life in an Iron Age village
parts.body: Re-creating life in an Iron Age village

questions.prompt: Jim says that in the Iron Age village

options.text: he is sometimes cold at night.
he always gets up early.
he has time to himself.

questions.prompt: What does Jim say about the food they eat in the village?

options.text: It takes time to prepare.
It is difficult to get used to.
It has to be eaten quickly.

questions.prompt: Jim says that at the evening meal

options.text: they are sometimes too tired to eat.
they mainly have fruit and berries.
they talk about what they've done.

questions.prompt: The most important job for the blacksmiths is

options.text: to mend broken tools and implements.
to maintain a good source of heat.
to collect sufficient firewood.

questions.prompt: Jim likes the fact that in the village, people

options.text: do varied activities.
share their knowledge.
get a lot of exercise.

parts.body: Presentation on how jobs might change in the future

questions.prompt: What do the students find surprising about the way that complaints were dealt with at the call centre?

options.text: the way that customers responded to it
the employees’s lack of enthusiasm for it
the kind of questions employees were obliged to ask

questions.prompt: What does Emma say about the report by Jerry Kaplan?

options.text: It shows how machines will respond to human needs.
It emphasises the variety of roles that machines will have.
It explains the limitations of machines.

questions.prompt: What is Nick's reaction to the article The Human Cloud?

options.text: He agrees that companies should focus on making savings.
He supports the concept of greater flexibility for employees.
He approves of businesses spending more on recruiting experts.

questions.prompt: What do the students agree about the use of technology to collect information about employees?

options.text: Cameras are an effective means of maintaining security.
Sometimes productivity is more important than individual privacy.
Employees may object to certain types of monitoring.
